ac.title: Account & privacy
ac.subtitle: Profile, security, sessions and your data.
ac.offline: Offline mode: account settings are only available again once the server can be reached.
ac.sessionsSub: Devices you are signed in on. End unknown sessions immediately.
ac.endAllMsg: All devices are signed out – including this one. Local copies on other devices are not deleted (remote wipe is not possible); but they are no longer connected to the server without signing in again.
ac.dataSub: Export, sync and adoption of local data.
ac.exportHint: The export uses the TERPGRID backup format (format 2) and can be imported again under “Data & backup” – also in local mode.
ac.profileSub: No real name, no email, no phone number.
ac.totpOn: Active – when signing in, a code from your authenticator app is also requested.
ac.totpOff: Not active. Recommended: protects your account if your password becomes known.
ac.totpDisableMsg: Your account will then only be protected by the password.
ac.regenMsg: All previous recovery codes become invalid immediately.
ac.newCodesSub: Only visible now. The old codes are invalid.
ac.passkeysSub: Sign in with your device’s screen lock or a security key – no password, no email. Your device decides which prompt appears; TERPGRID receives no biometric data.
ac.noPasskeys: This browser does not support passkeys.
ac.pkRemoveMsg: Signing in with this passkey will no longer be possible. Password and other passkeys stay valid.

ac2.typeId: To confirm, enter your login ID:

pendingLoss.one: {count} change has not been confirmed by the server yet and will be lost. Better sync first.
pendingLoss.other: {count} changes have not been confirmed by the server yet and will be lost. Better sync first.

ac2.unencrypted: The local copy is not encrypted. Encryption in the browser would require a key on the same device and would not really protect against people with access to the unlocked device. Protect the device itself (screen lock, device encryption).
ac2.deleteWarn: All content is removed immediately from the server and from this device. Download an export first if you want to keep the data. Encrypted copies remain in server backups until the retention expires. Local copies on other devices are only removed the next time TERPGRID is opened there (without offline permission) – remote wipe is not possible. You must transfer or delete shared spaces with other members first; your comments remain there as “Deleted account”.
ac2.sharedText: When signing out, the local copy is always deleted, your login ID is not remembered and continuing offline is off. Recommended for devices other people also use.
ac2.pwChangeSub: All other sessions will then be ended.
ac2.pwChanged: Password changed. Other sessions have been ended.
ac2.totpSetupSub: With an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator, 1Password).
ac2.scan: Scan the QR code with the app (or enter the key manually).
ac2.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
ac2.keyHint: Only visible here. The key is stored encrypted on the server.
ac2.allGood: Second factor and recovery codes in place
ac2.deviceSub: Local working copy in this browser – for offline use and sync.
ac2.sharedMem: Shared spaces are not stored permanently (only in memory while the app is open). The app loads the strain catalogue and Academy articles when needed; Academy texts are part of the app shell.
ac2.offOffMsg: The local copy is kept for this session until you sign out and is then deleted (untransferred changes are never discarded beforehand). Starting without a connection will then no longer be possible.
ac2.notOnShared: Not available on a shared device.
ac2.offlineText: On: your private data stays in this browser after signing out, and TERPGRID also starts without a connection. Off (default): the copy only serves the current session and is deleted when signing out or switching accounts.
ac2.persisted: The browser has granted persistent storage.
ac2.notPersisted: The browser has not granted persistent storage – it may remove the data when storage runs low (it stays on the server).
ac2.wipeMsg: The data is removed from this browser and then freshly loaded from the server. Nothing changes on the server.
ac2.pcSub: What TERPGRID stores, where and how it is protected – without exaggeration.
ac2.pcTrackingText: No analytics, advertising or tracking services. No email, no phone number, no real name.
ac2.delSub: Permanent – records, photos, documents, sessions and recovery codes.

pc.serverA: Grow logs, plants, photos, journal, collection, lab reports, settings. Content is encrypted with AES-256-GCM and a separate key per account; that key is protected by a master key that is not stored in the database.
pc.serverB: Whoever fully controls the running server (e.g. the operator with shell access) could technically decrypt. The administration deliberately has no function for this.
pc.meta: Login ID, display name, role, times of sign-ins and changes, number and size of records/files, shortened browser type per session. IP addresses only as a shortened, irreversible hash in the security log (default 180 days, configurable by the operator). The log never contains content, passwords, codes or keys.
pc.browserA: During the session, a working copy of your data (IndexedDB, separated per account,
pc.browserB: ), pending changes and the THC Lab input fields (localStorage). Beyond signing out, the copy only remains with offline use turned on (“This device”) – or as long as changes have not been transferred yet; only your own account can transfer them after signing in. Shared spaces are kept in memory only. The session cookie cannot be read by scripts. Keys are never stored in the browser.
pc.external: Discover uses StrainAPI and (on click) CannaLib via your server. The providers only see the server address and search terms – no personal data, no cookies.
pc.shared: Only what you explicitly share ends up in a shared space – with its own space key (separate from your account). Profile details are private by default and only visible to friends you allow; your login name is never visible to others. No public profiles, no directory, no disclosure outside this instance. Details and revocation: “Collaboration & sharing”.
pc.admin: Administrators see login IDs, status, storage use and system health – but no content. There is no master key and no hidden access function.
pc.backups: Server backups are additionally encrypted. After an account is deleted, (encrypted) data remains until the backup retention expires (by default up to about 6 months).

sy.conflictText: These entries were changed in the same field on another device (highlighted). TERPGRID merges changes to different fields automatically; nothing is overwritten automatically here – decide which version applies.
sy.howText: Every change is first saved on this device and then transferred to your server. It only counts as “synced” once the server has confirmed it. Photos and documents are loaded on other devices when needed. The data is stored encrypted on the server (the server operator could technically decrypt – not end-to-end encryption).
sy.offlineSub: Changes are collected on this device and transferred after the next sign-in.
sy.notConfirmed: Not yet confirmed by the server.
sy.title: Sync
sy.subtitle: Your data on this device and on your TERPGRID server.

im.confirmB: and stored encrypted on your server. Existing server data is not overwritten; differences appear as conflicts. The old local database is kept.

im.same: . Running again does not create duplicates.
